full_judgment: Md Nazrul Islam Talukder J: This Rule, at the 'instance of the convict-petitioner, was issued calling upon the opposite-party to show cause as to why the judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 19-7-2006 passed by the learned Judge of the Special Tribunal No. 4, Dhaka in Special Tribunal Cate No. 144 of 1999 arising out of Keranigonj Police Station Case No. 11 dated 4-12-1998 corresponding to GR No. 412 of 1998 convicting the convict-petitioner under section 4 of the Explosive Sub sentence Act, 1908  and sentence him thereunder to suffer rigorous imprisonment  for 7(seven) years and to pay a fine of taka 5,000 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment  for 6(six) months more should not be quashed and/or pass such other or further Order or orders as to this Court may seem it and proper.
